why: The fourth doubling of the real-content fit corpus (preregistration 0025) nests on 0024's pool and needs new plaintexts only where 0024's candidate frame runs out (py_src and rfc_txt). Every new file is pinned by sha256 here; tools/pivot/corpus_realfit3.py refuses to build from a file whose bytes differ, and refuses unless 0024's pinned sources are present and byte-identical too, so a cold clone rebuilds byte-identically or says why it cannot. Nothing in data/pivot/ext_src3 is committed.

nested_on.rule: per family the blob is 0024's blob byte for byte (0024's archives in 0024's order, 0024's rfc2 files) followed by the new archives' matching members and the rfc3 files; 0024's candidates and pool therefore recur unchanged and first, and the new pool positions continue 0024's chunk ids

selection_of_projects: the same five real families, from projects pinned by neither 0018 nor 0024: twelve more PyPI source distributions (their .py feed py_src and their .rst feed rst_doc; vendored copies of other projects under _vendor, vendored or ext directories are excluded by the member rule, and every new chunk is also dropped if it shares a run of 1024 bytes with 0024's blob of the same family or with any 0018 pinned file) and 600 more RFC texts drawn by 0024's rule from the RFC Editor's index as served on the fetch date, excluding every RFC pinned by 0018 or 0024 and every RFC related to a 0018-pinned RFC by an Obsoletes, Obsoleted by, Updates or Updated by annotation in either direction. c_src, pe_bin and rst_doc need no new project: their fourth doubling comes from 0024's unused candidates of 0024's archives.
pool_rule: per family, 0021's chunks-with-rows x (2^doublings - 1) x (1 + pool_margin) + pool_extra pool positions in all; the first are 0024's pool in 0024's order, the rest are np.random.default_rng([seed, family_index + 1])'s permutation of the remaining candidates (0024's unused candidates and the new files' candidates, in blob order), taken in that order

c_src.note: no new archive: the fourth doubling comes from 0024's unused candidates

pe_bin.note: no new archive: the fourth doubling comes from 0024's unused candidates

sample.rule: random.Random(20260923).sample over every RFC the RFC Editor's index lists as issued with a TXT format, not pinned by 0018 or 0024, and not related to a 0018-pinned RFC by an Obsoletes, Obsoleted by, Updates or Updated by annotation in either direction; 600 drawn, sorted
sample.candidates_sha256_is: sha256 of json.dumps of the sorted candidate numbers
sample.frame_note: the frame is every index entry, RFC 1 upward, listed as issued with a TXT format; 0024's frame (7838 candidates) had omitted the entries numbered below 1000 and five whose annotation wrapped a line, which CORRECTIONS.md records; none of 0024's 600 drawn files is related to a 0018 pin under the corrected parser
